title: The 5 Longest Rivers on Earth, Ranked (Number 1 Is Disputed)

scenes.text: The five longest rivers on Earth, ranked. Scientists still argue about number one.
Number five: the Yenisey system in Russia. About fifty-five hundred kilometers, with its source in Mongolia.
scenes.label: Yenisey · 5,500 km

scenes.text: Number four: the Mississippi and Missouri. Roughly six thousand kilometers from Montana to the Gulf of Mexico.
scenes.label: Mississippi · 6,000 km

scenes.text: Number three: the Yangtze, the longest river in Asia. Sixty-three hundred kilometers across China.
scenes.label: Yangtze · 6,300 km

scenes.text: Number two: the Amazon. Sixty-four hundred kilometers, and it carries more water than any other river on Earth.
scenes.label: Amazon · 6,400 km

scenes.text: Number one: the Nile. Sixty-six hundred fifty kilometers, only a little longer than the Amazon, depending on how you measure.
scenes.label: Nile · 6,650 km

description:
The five longest rivers on Earth, ranked by length.
The Nile and the Amazon are so close that scientists still debate how to measure them.
Which river would you want to travel?
first_comment: Nile or Amazon: which one is really longer? What should we rank next?
